SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(s.NumTstTakr, 0)) / COUNT(s.CDSCode), 2) AS AvgSATTestTakers
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles' AND s.OpenDate BETWEEN '2007-01-01' AND '2007-12-31' AND s.DocType = 'County Office of Education';

SELECT 
    T1.`County Name`, 
    COUNT(T1.CDSCode) AS `Number of Schools`, 
    ROUND(AVG(T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`), 2) AS `Average Free-Meal Percentage`, 
    ROUND(AVG(T1.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`), 2) AS `Average FRPM Percentage`, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Number of Charter Schools`, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Number of Non-Charter Schools`, 
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.cds IS NOT NULL THEN T2.AvgScrRead + T2.AvgScrMath + T2.AvgScrWrite ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(T1.CDSCode), 2) AS `Average SAT Score`
FROM 
    frpm AS T1
LEFT JOIN 
    satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE 
    T1.CDSCode IN (
        SELECT 
            CDSCode 
        FROM 
            frpm 
        WHERE 
            `Enrollment (K-12)` > 500 AND `FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700
    )
GROUP BY 
    T1.`County Name`;

SELECT 
    s.School, 
    ROUND(f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 4) AS FreeMealRate,
    CASE WHEN s.Charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' 
         WHEN s.Charter = 0 THEN 'No' 
         ELSE 'Unknown' 
    END AS Charter,
    s.GSserved AS GradesServed,
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(sats.AvgScrRead, sats.AvgScrMath, sats.AvgScrWrite) IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
        WHEN sats.AvgScrRead + sats.AvgScrMath + sats.AvgScrWrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
        WHEN sats.AvgScrRead + sats.AvgScrMath + sats.AvgScrWrite BETWEEN 1200 AND 1500 THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Above Average'
    END AS SATPerformanceLevel
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN 
    satscores sats ON f.CDSCode = sats.cds
WHERE 
    f.`High Grade` = '12' AND s.GSserved LIKE '%12%'
ORDER BY 
    FreeMealRate DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.School AS SchoolName,
    s.Phone,
    s.Website,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ss.rtype = 'Math' THEN ss.AvgScrMath ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN ss.rtype = 'Math' THEN ss.AvgScrMath ELSE 0 END), 0) AS AvgScrMath,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ss.rtype = 'Reading' THEN ss.AvgScrRead ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN ss.rtype = 'Reading' THEN ss.AvgScrRead ELSE 0 END), 0) AS AvgScrRead,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ss.rtype = 'Writing' THEN ss.AvgScrWrite ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN ss.rtype = 'Writing' THEN ss.AvgScrWrite ELSE 0 END), 0) AS AvgScrWrite,
    s.Charter,
    frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS K12Enrollment,
    ROUND(frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`, 2) AS FreeMealPercent,
    (SELECT MAX(AvgScrMath) 
     FROM satscores 
     WHERE cds IN (SELECT CDSCode FROM schools WHERE StatusType = 'Active') 
       AND NumTstTakr >= 10) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ss.rtype = 'Math' THEN ss.AvgScrMath ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN ss.rtype = 'Math' THEN ss.AvgScrMath ELSE 0 END), 0) AS MathScoreBelowHighest
FROM 
    schools s
LEFT JOIN 
    satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
LEFT JOIN 
    frpm ON s.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.CDSCode = '7618040113118';

WITH VirtualSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        s.County,
        s.School,
        AVG(sats.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore
    FROM 
        schools s
    LEFT JOIN 
        satscores sats ON s.CDSCode = sats.cds
    WHERE 
        s.Virtual = 'F'
    GROUP BY 
        s.County, s.School
),
RankedVirtualSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        County,
        COUNT(School) AS VirtualSchoolCount,
        MAX(AvgReadingScore) AS MaxReadingScore
    FROM 
        VirtualSchools
    GROUP BY 
        County
),
TopCounties AS (
    SELECT 
        County,
        VirtualSchoolCount,
        MaxReadingScore
    FROM 
        RankedVirtualSchools
    ORDER BY 
        VirtualSchoolCount DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
TopVirtualSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        v.County,
        v.School,
        v.AvgReadingScore
    FROM 
        VirtualSchools v
    JOIN 
        TopCounties tc ON v.County = tc.County
    WHERE 
        v.AvgReadingScore = tc.MaxReadingScore
)
SELECT 
    tc.County,
    tc.VirtualSchoolCount,
    COALESCE(TVS.School, 'None') AS HighestReadingSchool
FROM 
    TopCounties tc
LEFT JOIN 
    TopVirtualSchools TVS ON tc.County = TVS.County AND tc.MaxReadingScore = TVS.AvgReadingScore
ORDER BY 
    tc.VirtualSchoolCount DESC;

    ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.frameVersion = ( SELECT frameVersion FROM cards WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf' ORDER BY originalReleaseDate DESC LIMIT 1 ) THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) * 100.0 / COUNT(T1.frameVersion), 2) AS percentage_newest_frame

SELECT 
    s1.name AS first_set_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.convertedManaCost <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(c.id), 2) AS first_set_percentage,
    s2.name AS most_recent_set_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.convertedManaCost <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(c.id), 2) AS most_recent_set_percentage
FROM 
    cards c
JOIN 
    sets s1 ON c.setCode = s1.code
JOIN 
    sets s2 ON c.setCode = s2.code

    c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
    AND s1.releaseDate = (SELECT MIN(releaseDate) FROM sets WHERE code IN (SELECT setCode FROM cards WHERE name = 'Abyssal Horror'))
    AND s2.releaseDate = (SELECT MAX(releaseDate) FROM sets)
GROUP BY 
    s1.name, s2.name;

WITH district_info AS (
    SELECT 
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.region,
        COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts_opened,
        AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM 
        district d
    JOIN 
        disp disp ON d.district_id = disp.district_id
    JOIN 
        account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE 
        a.date BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31'
        AND t.date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY 
        d.district_id, d.A2, d.region
),
region_avg_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(avg_balance) AS region_avg
    FROM 
        district_info
)
SELECT 
    district_name,
    num_accounts_opened,
    ROUND(avg_balance, 2) AS avg_balance,
    (SELECT region_avg FROM region_avg_balance) AS region_avg,
    (SELECT district_name FROM district_info ORDER BY avg_balance DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 1) AS highest_avg_district
FROM 
    district_info
ORDER BY 
    district_name;
